recipient.heading: KUDOS RECIPIENTS: HERO BADGES FOR POSITIVE IMPACT
recipient.body: Based on the number of teammates who send you Kudos, you will earn the corresponding Hero Badge, displayed directly next to your profile name.

sender.heading: KUDOS SENDERS: COLLECT ALL 6 ICONS AND WIN A MYSTERY GIFT
sender.body: Every Kudos you send will be published on the system and collect ❤️ reactions from the Sunner community. For every 5 ❤️ reactions, you unlock 1 Secret Box, giving you a chance to receive one of the 6 exclusive SAA icons.
sender.footerText: Sunners who collect all 6 icons will receive a mystery gift from SAA 2025.

newHero.description: The journey of spreading positivity begins — your first words of gratitude and recognition have found their way to you.

risingHero.description: Your image is steadily growing in the hearts of your teammates through your kindness and dedication.

superHero.description: You have become a trusted and beloved symbol — someone always ready to help and remembered by many teammates.

legendHero.condition: More than 20 teammates have sent you Kudos
legendHero.description: You have become a legend — someone who left an unforgettable mark on the team through the sincerity of your heart and actions.

kudosQuocDan.heading: KUDOS QUOC DAN
kudosQuocDan.body: The 5 Kudos that receive the most ❤️ reactions across all of Sun* will officially become Kudos Quoc Dan and be awarded a special prize from SAA 2025: Root Further.
